item.title: Week 10: Rams at Cardinals
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 4:05 PM ET | Line: LA -9.5 · O/U 38.5 | Model ARI 18% vs. market 19% | On paper the Rams have the edge (The Rams rank 2nd in pressure rate, 20%). Under center, Matthew Stafford ranks 15th of 31 in EPA per dropback; x-factor: Puka Nacua gets 31% of the Rams' targets and 32% of its air yards, and his WOPR (0.81) ranks 2nd of 108. Arizona's pass defense ranks 29th. The model favors the Rams at 82%, mostly on rushing matchup (5.2 pts) and passing matchup (4.6 pts).
